subject: Trial qualification & model contingency — next steps and owners
messages:
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma@luminex.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Trial qualification & model contingency — next steps and owners

Hi Emma — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and an actionable plan so we can get a short POC stood up next week. Please feel free to correct anything I mis-captured.

Call summary (5–10 min):
- Goal: 2-week trial to validate multilingual NLU for clinical scheduling and triage across EN / FR / ES. Primary focus is intent accuracy, slot extraction, and hallucination rate on customer prompts.
- Usage profile: ~120 requests/min peak, typical request length 30–120 tokens, session-based KV cache will matter for short conversations.
- Data: You will provide a sample of 1k deidentified chat transcripts + 200 labeled test prompts (per locale) for automated scoring.

Proposed trial scope & acceptance criteria (proposed):
- Duration: 2 weeks active testing + 1 week buffer for config & handoff. Kickoff target: Mon 24 May 2027.
- Models to test: Primary candidate — Llama-2-13B-chat (q4_0 quantized) hosted on a dedicated pool; Fallback candidate — Mistral-Instruct-7B quantized (faster, lower cost) for degraded capacity.
- Multilingual strategy: Run EN baseline, then FR/ES with dedicated prompt templates and locale-specific few-shot examples. If FR/ES performance lags by >8% relative to EN, we will test locale-specific fine-tuning with a 48-hour micro-tune (if agreed).
- Success metrics (examples):
  - Intent accuracy >= 88% on your labeled test set (per-locale median).
  - Slot extraction F1 >= 85%.
  - Hallucination < 3% (manual sample of 200 responses).
  - Latency SLO: p95 generation < 500ms for median input length.

Eval plan and ownership:
- Rishi (me): coordinate prompts, collect Luminex test sets, run daily automated evals, weekly demo.
- Aditya Rao: infra + model config (quantization profile, batching, caching), set up Dedicated pool and trace collection.
- Lauren Bishop: CS lead for acceptance criteria, business sign-off, and post-trial decision.
- Luminex (Emma + Jordan): provide labeled test set, list of 20 high-priority utterances per locale, and internal acceptance approver.

Attachments / artifacts:
- I attached a proposed trial config (redwood-trial-config.yaml) with model variants, batching targets, and logging settings.
- We'll share a short SOC2/security deck and the standard DPA via Drive link once you confirm kickoff.

Next steps (action items):
1) Emma: confirm sample data availability and NDA timing by Thu 20 May.
2) Rishi: schedule kickoff for Mon 24 May 10am PT if data is greenlit.
3) Aditya: provision a 2-node dedicated pool with q4 quant profile and enable prefix cache before kickoff.
4) Lauren: draft acceptance checklist and share with Emma by Fri 21 May.

If that all looks right I'll spin up the infra tickets and send a calendar invite for kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

— Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0193

From: Emma Liu <emma@luminex.ai>

Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial qualification & model contingency — next steps and owners

Thanks Rishi — this is super helpful and tracks with what we discussed. Quick answers and a couple of asks: 

- Data: We can provide the 1k deidentified transcripts and 200 labeled prompts per locale by Friday EOD. I will confirm with Legal on the NDA timing (we have a standard MSA in flight).
- Timeline: 24 May kickoff looks fine for our team — Jordan will be the day-to-day contact for engineering.
- Models/fallback: We like the idea of primary = Llama-2-13B-chat (q4). Can you confirm expected cost delta vs Mistral-7B fallback for the 2-week run? We need a rough cost estimate for procurement.
- Security: please share SOC2 summary and where logs will be retained. Also attaching our security questionnaire for your Security/Compliance team to review (Attachment: Luminex_Security_Q.pdf).

Small request on evaluation: our clinical reviewers prefer a per-locale confusion matrix and some example failure traces (5 worst cases per locale) so they can triage hallucinations quickly. Can you build that into the daily eval?

Thanks — Emma
Emma Liu
Head of Product, Luminex Health
emma@luminex.ai

Attachment: Luminex_Security_Q.pdf (pdf, 243 KB)

Emma — great, thanks for the quick turnaround. Short responses and I'll take the action items listed below.

- Cost delta: Rough estimate (2-week dedicated run, with expected 80% PV busy): Llama-2-13B-chat (q4) ~= $5.8k; Mistral-7B fallback ~= $2.1k. I'll get a line-item breakdown from Finance for procurement but those should be good planning numbers.
- Security / logs: SOC2 summary: https://redwood.example.com/soc2-deck. Logs and traces for the trial will be retained in your VPC-only bucket for 90 days (default trial retention) unless you ask for shorter retention — we will generate audit logs for every request and provide obfuscated payloads for compliance review.
- Eval outputs: We'll include per-locale confusion matrices + an automatic "top-5 failure traces" export each night. Aditya will wire up the eval harness to produce those CSVs into the Drive folder.

Action items I will take immediately:
1) Provision trial infra and share the provisioning ticket ID: RDW-8241 (aditya, please confirm ETA).
2) Post the trial config to the Drive folder and email the invite once infra is provisioned. (Attachment: redwood-trial-config.yaml)
3) Draft acceptance checklist and share with Emma & Jordan by Fri 21 May (Lauren).

Aditya — can you confirm that a q4 profile and the fallback Mistral image are both available for the dedicated pool? If you need me to pre-bake prompt templates or test prompts, give me a heads up and I'll upload.

Thanks all — will follow up with the kickoff invite once infra is green.
